utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Jadranko Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Madam Registrar. Today we are Tuesday the 13th of February, and I greet everybody present in the courtroom. The Prosecution, the Defence counsel, the accused and everybody who is assisting us in our work. I have to render an oral decision, and then I'm going to give the floor to Madam Registrar. It has the decision regarding the request of the Prosecution of 7th of February, with regard to P 00996, and P 03105. Pursuant to the order with respect to the admission of exhibits linked to Witness CR on the 23rd of January, 2007, the Prosecution on the 7th of February, 2007, furnished a new translation of P 00998 and P 03305. The Chamber considers that the translations are satisfactory and therefore decides to admit the exhibits mentioned under seal. That is the oral ruling. Madam Registrar, two IC numbers, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The next two IC numbers would be IC 400 and IC 401.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. We're going to move into private session [as interpreted] now, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 14th day of February, 2007, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.44 p.m.,
